newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Fitzwilton to raise Waterford Wedgwood stake.
newsitem.headline: Fitzwilton to raise Waterford Wedgwood stake.

text.p: Irish industrial holding group Fitzwilton Plc said on Thursday that it intends to exercise its option later this month to puchase a further 3.64 percent of Waterford Wedgwood at a cost of around 24 million punts.
This will take Fitzwilton's stake in the crystal and fine china group to 16.4 percent from 12.8 percent, the company said in a statement.

After exercising the option, Fitzwilton will have voting control over 19.94 percent of Waterford Wedgwood while the families of Fitzwilton chairman Tony O'Reilly and his wife Chryss Goulandris will control a further 7.39 percent.
Fitzwilton said the present market value of its investment in Waterford Wedgwood is 83 million Irish pounds, representing a paper profit of 40 million.
"Fitzwilton is very pleased with its highly successful involvement in Waterford Wedgwood and looks forward with confidence to the achievement of continued growth in the years ahead," it said.
Last year, Waterford Wedgwood reported a 24 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 34.9 million Irish pounds on turnover of 376.3 million, a nine percent rise.
